title: Photon
description: Connects Zelos to the Photon telemetry server. Load stored car sessions into the app, or upload them to Zelos Cloud (always tagged Photon).

photon_url.title: Photon URL
photon_url.description: Base URL of the Photon web UI. The extension uses its /ws catalog and /export.csv endpoints.

password.title: Photon password
password.description: The shared Photon web password (user 'photon'). Stored only in this extension's settings.

timezone.title: Time zone for session labels
timezone.description: IANA zone used to group sessions into days and label start times. Data timestamps are always UTC.

default_resolution.title: Default resolution
default_resolution.description: Resolution used when a load or upload doesn't pick one.

traces_dir.title: Trace folder
traces_dir.description: Where Load Session saves .trz files. Empty uses Documents/Photon Traces.

organization.title: Zelos organization
organization.description: Org slug for Cloud uploads. Leave empty for your active organization.
